name: Carmelo
source:
He/Him

Carmelo is a song dragon from Calida City who comes from a family with very traditional values. He loves music and dreams of being a freelance bard despite his father's disapproval.

He is very lively, compassionate and a bit of a tease with those he likes. Carmelo is also very touchy feely and affectionate with Vance.

Unlike his boyfriend, Carmelo tends to care too much about what others think and is more likely to bottle things up until he explodes with anger or sadness. He sadly isn't able to be himself when around his "family."

[From [url=https://prikarin.itch.io/azure-flame]itch.io[/url]]
